text: 据企查查APP显示，近日，上海路威澄雅企业管理合伙企业（有限合伙）成立，出资额约3.1亿元，经营范围为企业管理、企业管理咨询。企查查股权穿透显示，该企业由路威凯腾（海南）企业管理咨询中心（有限合伙）、路威凯腾（成都）私募基金管理有限公司共同出资。（证券时报）
text_en: According to Qichacha APP, Shanghai Luwei Chengya Enterprise Management Partnership (Limited Partnership) was recently established with capital contributions of about 310 million yuan, with business scope covering enterprise management and enterprise management consulting. Qichacha equity penetration shows that the entity is jointly funded by L Catterton (Hainan) Enterprise Management Consulting Center (Limited Partnership) and L Catterton (Chengdu) Private Equity Fund Management Co., Ltd. (Securities Times)
